description: This file contains unit tests for JSON serialization and deserialization extension methods within the application core. It includes test cases for converting objects to JSON strings and parsing JSON strings back into objects, utilizing the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: Contains unit tests for JSON extension methods that serialize and deserialize objects to and from JSON strings.

methods.name: CorrectlySerializesAndDeserializesObject
methods.description: Tests that an object can be serialized to JSON and then deserialized back to an equivalent object.

methods.name: CorrectlyDeserializesJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization of JSON strings into objects, verifying expected property values for various input data.
